name: code_tests
description: Find the test files and test functions that exercise a symbol (transitive callers, depth 2). Use this to run targeted tests for the code you changed instead of the full suite. Prefer this over Grep for test discovery -- the call graph is pre-indexed. Scope: always the calling session's own repo -- a member session uses its registered work folder, any other session the fleet server's working folder; there is no repo/path scope argument. Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER or E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO when that folder is missing or is not a git repository, E-CODE-INDEX-NOT-READY when it has no code index yet or the index is still building, and E-CODE-INTEL-DISABLED when code intelligence is off (each with a one-line remediation).
